Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Indiana Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 59,951,925 megawatthours
B. 37,060,955 megawatthours

Source citation: Indiana Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/indiana/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: B
